use default

use EDGE = (start: string, finish: string, cost: int)
use REACHED = (cost: int, previous: string)

shortest_paths(edges: EDGE[], nodes: string[], source: string)
    -> MAP[string, REACHED] is
    let best = MAP[string, REACHED]()
    let unvisited = LIST(nodes)

    best[source] = (cost = 0, previous = "")

    while let nearest = unvisited
        |> filter(node => best.contains_key(node))
        |> min_by(node => best[node].cost)
    do
        unvisited.remove(nearest)

        for edge in edges |> filter(edge => edge.start =~ nearest) do
            let through = best[nearest].cost + edge.cost

            if !best.contains_key(edge.finish) \/
                through < best[edge.finish].cost then
                best[edge.finish] = (cost = through, previous = nearest)
            fi
        od
    od

    best
si

route(best: MAP[string, REACHED], node: string) -> string =>
    if best[node].previous.length == 0 then
        node
    else
        "{route(best, best[node].previous)} -> {node}"
    fi
